numeric_normalization.duration: normalize explicit seconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds to milliseconds
numeric_normalization.memory: normalize explicit KiB, GiB, KB, and GB to MB using the unit written by the source
numeric_normalization.scaled_counts: expand explicit k, M, and G suffixes by powers of 1000

rules: Use an explicit metric label from the same row, column, or sentence when present.
Validation and test prefixes remain part of a metric only when the source explicitly distinguishes them.
For unlabeled benchmark time columns use runtime_ms; use latency_ms only when latency is explicit.
For operations, requests, rows, tokens, samples, or items per time use throughput unless a canonical labeled rate exists.
Do not label targets, limits, thresholds, hyperparameters, input dimensions, counts of test cases, or dates as outcomes.
Do not derive ratios or deltas that the source does not print.
If a cell prints multiple independently labeled outcomes, annotate each one.
If the same outcome appears twice in the registered block, annotate both occurrences.
